query: Периодически выбирай новые записи из PostgreSQL и публикуй их в Kafka topic analytics.events в формате JSON.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: postgres_to_kafka_pipeline
  name: PostgreSQL to Kafka Analytics Pipeline
  description: Периодически выбирает новые записи из PostgreSQL и публикует их в Kafka
    topic analytics.events в формате JSON
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 1 minute
sources:
- id: source_postgres
  name: Read New Records from PostgreSQL
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: '{{DB_SCHEMA}}.{{DB_TABLE}}'
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DB_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_filter_new
  name: Filter New Records
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: created_at > {{LAST_PROCESSED_TIMESTAMP}}
    watermark_field: created_at
    state_store: '{{WATERMARK_STATE_STORE}}'
- id: process_serialize_json
  name: Serialize to JSON
  operation: Serialize
  config:
    format: json
    include_schema: 'false'
sinks:
- id: sink_kafka
  name: Publish to Kafka analytics.events
  type: Kafka
  location: analytics.events
  connection:
    properties:
      brokers: '{{KAFKA_BROKERS}}'
      acks: all
      key_serializer: org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringSerializer
      value_serializer: org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringSerializer
processed_data:
- id: raw_records
  format: tabular
- id: filtered_records
  format: tabular
- id: json_records
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_postgres
  to_id: process_filter_new
  data_ref: raw_records
- from_id: process_filter_new
  to_id: process_serialize_json
  data_ref: filtered_records
- from_id: process_serialize_json
  to_id: sink_kafka
  data_ref: json_records
